objective: Compile a portable Academy skill that justifies and composes the minimum human-accountable agent team while failing closed on authority, privacy, budget, security, and termination gaps.

deliverables.description: An Agent Skills-compatible team composition package with necessity, permission, escalation, and inactive-until-proven gates.

context.audience: Academy architects, agent engineers, institutions, accountable operators, privacy owners, and learners

stakes.rationale: An overpowered or opaque agent team can expose learner data, spend funds, or make unauthorized decisions; an inactive manifest can be rejected before runtime activation.

must: Prove at least one durable boundary for every proposed persistent role.
Pin build, attestation, delegation, tools, data, budget, escalation, termination, and accountable human.
Keep every agent inactive until behavioral, security, drift, and human activation evidence pass.
mustNot: Create an agent only for a persona, title, or promise of intelligence.
Grant graph merge, publication, credential, payment, installation, external-message, or permission-expansion authority.
Allow unbounded loops, silent shared-state overwrite, cross-tenant reads, or self-activation.

completionTests.value: Each retained agent has at least one durable boundary
